import { expect, test, vi } from "vitest"
import { createGoIdentityAdapter, registrationPasswordPolicy } from "./adapter"
import { isServiceAccount, isServiceProfile } from "./goContract"
import { APP_CONFIG } from "../../../config/environment"
import { requestGoTransport } from "../client/goTransport"

/** 新密码规则采用服务端的 UTF-8 字节长度和字母数字要求。 */
test("registration password policy matches Go validation", () => {
  for (const value of ["abcdefgh", "12345678", "Short1", "a1" + "中".repeat(21)])
    expect(registrationPasswordPolicy.validate(value)).toBe(false)
  for (const value of ["Example123", "密码A1", "a1" + "中".repeat(20)])
    expect(registrationPasswordPolicy.validate(value)).toBe(true)
  expect(registrationPasswordPolicy.errorKey("a1")).toBe("registrationPasswordTooShort")
  expect(registrationPasswordPolicy.errorKey("a1" + "中".repeat(21))).toBe("registrationPasswordTooLong")
  expect(registrationPasswordPolicy.errorKey("abcdefgh")).toBe("registrationPasswordGoRule")
})

/** 真实 SQLite/HTTP 验证公开隔离、完整资料、刷新复用、改密及全账号退出。 */
test("real Go endpoints match the frontend adapter and token lifecycle", async () => {
  const adapter = createGoIdentityAdapter()
  await expect(adapter.register({ email: "contract@example.invalid", password: "Example123" })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 400, code: "verification.code.required" })
  const receipt = await adapter.sendRegistrationCode("contract@example.invalid")
  if (!receipt.mocked) throw new Error("fixture delivery not mocked")
  expect(receipt.codeLength).toBe(6)
  expect(receipt.expiresAt).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now())
  await expect(adapter.register({ email: "contract@example.invalid", password: "Example123", code: receipt.code === "999999" ? "888888" : "999999" })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 400, code: "verification.code.invalid" })
  const id = await adapter.register({
    code: receipt.code,
    email: "contract@example.invalid",
    password: "Example123"
  })
  expect(id).toMatch(/^[1-9][0-9]*$/u)
  await expect(adapter.register({ email: "contract@example.invalid", password: "Example123", code: receipt.code })).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 400 })
  for (const scene of ["reset_password", "RESET_PASSWORD", " reset_password "]) {
    const reset = await fetch(APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl + "/api/v1/auth/verification-code", {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ target: "contract@example.invalid", target_type: "email", scene })
    })
    expect(reset.status).toBe(400)
  }
  const repeated = await adapter.sendRegistrationCode("contract@example.invalid")
  if (!repeated.mocked) throw new Error("fixture delivery not mocked")
  await expect(
    adapter.register({
      code: repeated.code,
      email: "contract@example.invalid",
      password: "Example123"
    })
  ).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 409, code: "account.exists" })
  await expect(
    adapter.api.login({ account: "contract@example.invalid", password: "wrong" })
  ).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 401, code: "auth.credentials.invalid" })
  const access = await adapter.api.login({
    account: "contract@example.invalid",
    password: "Example123"
  })
  expect(await adapter.api.validate(access)).toMatchObject({
    id,
    displayName: expect.stringMatching(/^用户 /u)
  })
  const profile = await adapter.readProfile(access)
  expect(profile.account).toMatchObject({
    id,
    nickname: expect.stringMatching(/^用户 /u),
    phone: null,
    status: 1
  })
  expect(Number.isSafeInteger(profile.account.created_time)).toBe(true)
  expect(profile.organizationUser).toMatchObject({
    accountId: id,
    organizationId: profile.organization.id,
    role: "owner"
  })
  for (const nickname of ["", "   ", "x".repeat(65)]) {
    const rejected = await fetch(APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl + "/api/v1/auth/profile", {
      method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + access },
      body: JSON.stringify({ nickname })
    })
    expect(rejected.status).toBe(400)
  }
  const renamed = await fetch(APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl + "/api/v1/auth/profile", {
    method: "PATCH", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + access },
    body: JSON.stringify({ nickname: "  New nickname  ", account_id: "1", email: "forged@example.invalid" })
  })
  expect(renamed.status).toBe(200)
  expect((await adapter.readProfile(access)).account).toMatchObject({ id, nickname: "New nickname", email: "contract@example.invalid" })
  expect(await adapter.api.validate(access)).toMatchObject({ id, displayName: "New nickname", email: "contract@example.invalid" })
  const response = await fetch(APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl + "/api/v1/auth/login", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ account: "contract@example.invalid", password: "Example123" })
  })
  const result = await response.json()
  const refreshToken = result.data.token.refresh_token
  await expect(adapter.refresh(access)).rejects.toMatchObject({
    status: 401,
    code: "auth.token.invalid"
  })
  await expect(adapter.api.validate(refreshToken)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "expired" })
  expect((await adapter.refresh(refreshToken)).account.id).toBe(id)
  // 上游刷新不会吊销旧 refresh；不要把重发误当作单次轮换。
  expect((await adapter.refresh(refreshToken)).account.id).toBe(id)
  await adapter.changePassword(access, "Example123", "Changed123")
  await expect(adapter.api.validate(access)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "expired" })
  await expect(adapter.refresh(refreshToken)).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 401 })
  const next = await adapter.api.login({
    account: "contract@example.invalid",
    password: "Changed123"
  })
  const secondResponse = await fetch(APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl + "/api/v1/auth/login", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ account: "contract@example.invalid", password: "Changed123" })
  })
  const second = await secondResponse.json()
  await adapter.api.logout(next)
  await expect(adapter.refresh(second.data.token.refresh_token)).rejects.toMatchObject({
    status: 401,
    code: "auth.token.revoked"
  })
  await expect(adapter.api.validate(next)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "expired" })
})

/** 上游 nullable org 可被最小身份消费，但不能伪造 Workspace 成员或权限。 */
test("upstream profile remains distinct from the workspace member extension", async () => {
  const account = {
    id: "2108046372081659904",
    username: "user",
    email: "user@example.invalid",
    nickname: "",
    phone: null,
    status: 1,
    last_login_at: null,
    last_login_ip: "",
    created_time: 1790000000,
    updated_time: 1790000000
  }
  expect(isServiceAccount(account)).toBe(true)
  expect(isServiceProfile({ account, org: null })).toBe(true)
  expect(isServiceAccount({ ...account, created_time: "1790000000" })).toBe(false)
  const headers: Headers[] = []
  const spy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, "fetch").mockImplementation(async (input, init) => {
    headers.push(input instanceof Request ? input.headers : new Headers(init?.headers))
    const response = new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ model: "account", data: { account, org: null }, request_id: "fixture" }),
      { status: 200 }
    )
    Object.defineProperty(response, "url", {
      value: input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    })
    return response
  })
  try {
    await expect(
      createGoIdentityAdapter(undefined, "upstream").api.validate("opaque-access")
    ).resolves.toMatchObject({ id: account.id })
    await expect(createGoIdentityAdapter().api.validate("opaque-access")).rejects.toMatchObject({
      code: "invalidIdentity"
    })
    expect(headers[0]?.get("Authorization")).toBe("Bearer opaque-access")
    expect(headers[0]?.get("X-AUTH-TOKEN")).toBeNull()
    expect(headers[0]?.get("X-Request-Id")).not.toBe(headers[1]?.get("X-Request-Id"))
    spy.mockClear()
    await requestGoTransport(APP_CONFIG.apiBaseUrl, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: "Bearer injected",
        "X-Http-Request": "continuation",
        "X-Request-Id": "caller-owned"
      }
    })
    expect(headers.at(-1)?.get("Authorization")).toBeNull()
    expect(headers.at(-1)?.get("X-Http-Request")).toBeNull()
    expect(headers.at(-1)?.get("X-Request-Id")).not.toBe("caller-owned")
  } finally {
    spy.mockRestore()
  }
})

/** 非法令牌对和状态不能被登录或刷新采用；公开请求不带残留 Bearer。 */
test("malformed token responses fail closed for login and refresh", async () => {
  const headers: Headers[] = []
  const spy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, "fetch").mockImplementation(async (input, init) => {
    headers.push(input instanceof Request ? input.headers : new Headers(init?.headers))
    const response = new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        model: "auth.token",
        data: {
          token: {
            access_token: "valid",
            refresh_token: "refresh",
            token_type: "Basic",
            expires_in: 3600
          }
        },
        request_id: "fixture"
      }),
      { status: 200 }
    )
    Object.defineProperty(response, "url", {
      value: input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    })
    return response
  })
  try {
    const adapter = createGoIdentityAdapter()
    await expect(adapter.api.login({ account: "user", password: "secret" })).rejects.toThrow(
      "invalid_service_response"
    )
    await expect(adapter.refresh("opaque-refresh")).rejects.toThrow("invalid_service_response")
    expect(headers.every((header) => !header.has("Authorization"))).toBe(true)
  } finally {
    spy.mockRestore()
  }
})
